questions.q: 1 kilometre is how many metres?
500 metres is how many kilometres?
questions.why: 500 is half of 1,000, so it is half a kilometre: 0.5 km.

questions.q: 750 metres is how many kilometres?
questions.why: 750 out of 1,000 metres is 0.75 of one kilometre.

questions.q: Which is the same as 0.5?
questions.why: A zero at the end of a decimal does not change its value: 0.5 = 0.50.

questions.q: 2 km is how many metres?
3,500 metres is how many kilometres?
1,250 metres is how many kilometres?
questions.why: 1,250 ÷ 1,000 = 1.25 km. Moving the decimal point 3 places to the left.

questions.q: 0.6 km is how many metres?
2.4 km is how many metres?
4 km 300 m is how many metres?
Which is the longest?
questions.why: 1.8 km = 1,800 m, which is more than 1,750 m and 1.7 km (1,700 m).

questions.q: Which is the shortest?
questions.why: 0.4 km = 400 m, which is less than 420 m and 450 m.

questions.q: 1 km 500 m is how many kilometres?
questions.why: 500 m is half a kilometre, so 1 km 500 m = 1.5 km.

questions.q: 1 kilogram is how many grams?
2,500 g is how many kilograms?
0.75 kg is how many grams?
3.2 kg is how many grams?
Which is the heaviest?
questions.why: 1,400 g = 1.4 kg, which is more than 1.04 kg (1,040 g) and 0.9 kg (900 g).

questions.q: 1 metre is how many centimetres?
250 cm is how many metres?
0.8 m is how many centimetres?
1.35 m is how many centimetres?
6 cm is how many millimetres?
45 mm is how many centimetres?
1 litre is how many millilitres?
2,500 mL is how many litres?
0.5 L is how many millilitres?
Which is bigger?
questions.why: 0.7 is 70 hundredths and 0.65 is 65 hundredths, so 0.7 is bigger.

questions.q: Which decimal is the same as 3 tenths?
Which fraction is the same as 0.25?
How many hundredths is 0.07?
questions.why: 0.07 has 7 in the hundredths place, so it is 7 hundredths.

questions.q: Which is the smallest?
What is 1.6 + 0.3?
What is 2.5 + 0.75?
What is 5.4 − 2.9?
questions.why: 5.4 − 2.9 = 2.5. Think of it as 5 tenths 4 minus 2 tenths 9, or count: 2.9 + 2.5 = 5.4.

questions.q: What is 0.6 × 10?
questions.why: Multiplying by 10 moves the decimal point one place to the right: 0.6 × 10 = 6.

questions.q: What is 4.7 ÷ 10?
questions.why: Dividing by 10 moves the decimal point one place to the left: 4.7 ÷ 10 = 0.47.

questions.q: What is 0.25 × 100?
questions.why: Multiplying by 100 moves the decimal point two places to the right: 0.25 × 100 = 25.

questions.q: Ben runs 1.2 km. How many metres is that?
A bottle has 1.5 L of juice. Ana drinks 400 mL. How many mL are left?
A rope is 3 m long. Sam cuts off 75 cm. How many cm are left?
A box weighs 2.4 kg. Mia adds 350 g of tape. What is the total in grams?
Which is the same as 1 km 25 m?
Which is the same as 3.05 kg?
Which is the same as 0.08 m?
Which is the same as 0.125 L?
A ribbon is 2.8 m long. Sam uses 135 cm. How many cm are left?
A jug holds 2 L. 1 L 250 mL is poured out. How many mL remain?
Mia buys 3 bags of rice. Each bag is 1.5 kg. What is the total in grams?
A snail moves 0.6 m in 1 minute. How far does it go in 5 minutes?
Which is the biggest?
questions.why: 1.5 km = 1,500 m, which is bigger than 1,450 m and 1.04 km (1,040 m).

questions.q: Which mass is the smallest?
questions.why: 850 g is less than 0.9 kg (900 g) and 1.2 kg (1,200 g).

questions.q: Round 3.46 km to the nearest tenth of a kilometre.
questions.why: The digit after the tenths is 6, which is 5 or more, so round up: 3.5 km.

questions.q: Which decimal is between 0.4 and 0.5?
questions.why: 0.46 is more than 0.4 (0.40) and less than 0.5 (0.50).

questions.q: What is 0.3 of 1 kilometre, in metres?
What is 1/5 of 1 kilogram, in grams?
Which is the same as 4/5 of a litre?
Which fraction is the same as 0.375?
Which is the same as 0.2 of a metre?
Sara's pencil is 14.5 cm long. How long is it in millimetres?
A car drives 12.6 km on Monday and 850 m on Tuesday. What is the total in km?
Ella has 2 L 40 mL of juice. She pours 290 mL into each of 3 cups. How many mL are left?
Which is the same as 2.05 km?
A bag of sand weighs 1.25 kg. What is the total weight of 8 bags?
A tank has 3.6 L of water. 1,850 mL is used. How many mL are left?
Four friends share 2.5 kg of apples equally. How many grams does each friend get?
A road is 4.2 km long. 1.35 km is finished. How many metres are left?
A recipe needs 0.75 kg of flour for 6 muffins. How many grams are needed for 2 muffins?
questions.why: 6 muffins ÷ 3 = 2 muffins, so divide 0.75 kg by 3: 0.25 kg = 250 g.

questions.q: A wooden plank is 1.8 m long. You cut 4 pieces, each 45 cm long. How many cm are left over?
questions.why: 4 × 45 cm = 180 cm = 1.8 m. The whole plank is used up, so 0 cm is left.

questions.q: Which is correct?  0.6 kg ___ 650 g
questions.why: 0.6 kg = 600 g, and 600 g is less than 650 g.

questions.q: Which is the largest?
questions.why: 3,450 m = 3.45 km. That is larger than 0.4 km (400 m) and 0.35 km (350 m).

questions.q: What is 0.6 × 0.5?
What is 2.4 ÷ 0.6?
questions.why: Make both numbers whole by multiplying by 10: 24 ÷ 6 = 4.

questions.q: A water bottle holds 0.75 L. How many bottles are needed to fill a 3 L jug?
questions.why: 3 ÷ 0.75 = 4. Four bottles fill the jug exactly.

questions.q: A ribbon is 5 m long. You cut as many 0.4 m pieces as you can. How many whole pieces do you get?
questions.why: 5 ÷ 0.4 = 12.5, but you can only get 12 whole pieces (12 × 0.4 = 4.8 m, with 0.2 m left over).

questions.q: A box weighs 1 kg 35 g. Another box weighs 80 g more. What is the total weight in kg?
A runner completes 3 laps of 0.8 km each, then 650 m more. What is the total distance in km?
A rectangle is 5 cm long and 2 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
A square has sides of 6 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.why: A square has 4 equal sides: 4 × 6 = 24 cm.

questions.q: A rectangle is 1 m 20 cm long and 80 cm wide. What is its perimeter in cm?
questions.why: Length 120 cm + width 80 cm = 200 cm. Two of each side: 2 × 200 = 400 cm.

questions.q: What time is it 35 minutes after 2:40?
How many minutes are there from 9:20 to 10:05?
questions.why: 9:20 to 10:00 is 40 minutes, and 10:00 to 10:05 is 5 more: 45 minutes.

questions.q: How many minutes are in 2 hours 15 minutes?
A movie starts at 1:50 pm and lasts 1 hour 35 minutes. When does it end?
Lena leaves at 8:45 and arrives at 9:10. How long is her trip?
questions.why: 8:45 to 9:00 is 15 minutes, and 9:00 to 9:10 is 10 more: 25 minutes.

questions.q: A jug has 1 L of water. You pour out 250 mL. How much is left?
